blockers.reproduction: On Pixel 7 Chromium, create a synthetic Deriva level 2 course and open Impostazioni. Hold a synthetic legacy IndexedDB connection and arrange one selected-cache deletion to fail. Set viewport 320x844 and root font-size 200%. Use Azzera tutti i dati locali, acknowledge and tap Azzera i dati. The blocked screen displays Cancellazione dei dati locali… beyond the right edge. Close the held connection: Cancellazione non completata overflows identically. Expected all text within the viewport without horizontal scrolling; observed page width 348. The subsequent ordinary retry click timed out with the alert section intercepting pointer events; that is retained as corroborating browser output, not a separately proven device defect.

qolFindings.title: The first-start import action says replace when no course exists
qolFindings.reproduction: Start without a course and select a valid synthetic archive. Preview says Importare aggiunge questo corso al dispositivo and the checkbox says Confermo di importare questo corso sul dispositivo, but the final disabled/enabled action says Sostituisci il corso. Use an import label in the empty state so a hurried user does not have to reconcile the wording. Confirmation still protects the data; this is non-blocking.
